Jamie —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the MAP draft. Confirming high-level timeline: target close 2026-11-30 works for us provided legal review proceeds on the cadence below. Proposed responsibilities and turnaround (we can adjust if your legal asks for different SLAs):

MAP milestone: Legal review & redlines
- Owner: Acme legal to consolidate initial redlines; Redwood legal to own Redwood-side edits and finalize counter-redlines.
- Deliverables: consolidated redline Word doc (please avoid multiple inline PDF comment threads — a single track-changes Word file is easiest for us).
- Turnaround: Redwood legal will aim for 2 business days for commercial/negotiable edits, 4 business days for substantive legal redlines. If redlines are extensive (more than 10 substantive clause edits), allow up to 5 business days.
- Dependency: Need consolidated file and an indication of top-3 priority clauses (e.g., data retention, audit rights, SLA credits).

DPA & SLA: Redwood legal will take primary ownership of DPA text and SLA language adjustments (we own the standard DPA template and SLA commitments). We ask Acme legal to flag any non-standard requirements in the consolidated file.

Next steps:
1) Acme legal to consolidate redlines into one Word file and share by 2026-11-22.
2) Redwood legal (Dev) to review and return counter-redlines per the turnarounds above.
3) Schedule legal-to-legal call if needed (propose Tue 2026-11-23, 10am PT).

I’ve CC'd Dev from our legal team and Aditya (sales lead) to keep them in the loop.

Thanks — I’ll standby for the consolidated redline file and priority list.

Best,
Marissa Cole
